headlines.title: The Best Value Stocks to Buy
headlines.summary: Value stocks can be defined differently depending on who you ask. Here, we look at ways to measure valuation and how investors can find the best value stocks.

headlines.title: Tesla Just Keeps Crashing: One of Wall Street’s Most Outspoken Names Sees 80% Gains Anyway
headlines.summary: Tesla's earnings just delivered a brutal profit shock, yet one of Wall Street's loudest voices is calling for 80% gains from here. The bull and bear cases could not be further apart, and the gap reveals everything about what this stock has become.

headlines.title: Tesla’s China Numbers Show It Is On The Road To Comeback
headlines.summary: Tesla's stock has cratered 26% this year while rivals circle, but a fresh wave of data from the world's largest car market suggests the company's fortunes may be shifting faster than Wall Street expected.

headlines.title: Why Is General Motors Exiting Its Indiana Battery Joint Venture?
headlines.summary: GM is exiting its Indiana battery JV with Samsung SDI as weaker EV demand prompts a pullback in battery investments.

headlines.title: How Will GM's $4.5B Parts Plan Shield It From Supply Shocks?
headlines.summary: General Motors' $4.5B parts plan aims to shield production from supply shocks by securing critical inventory ahead of potential disruptions.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
